title: DR1 asks for the means of transport as a select defaulting to "Select one"; the frontend asks it as four radios with nothing preselected, which reads as a bigger question than the page treats it as.

finding.frontend: Means of transport to the port of entry is a radios group of four — Airplane, Railway, Road Vehicle, Vessel — occupying about a fifth of the page between the port-of-entry search and the transport identification field (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/port-of-entry/port-of-entry.njk:29-38). It is one of five questions on a page of five, and it is the only one presented as a fieldset of options rather than as a single control, so it dominates a page where the four questions around it are compact.
finding.prototype: DR1 asks the same question with the same four options as a govuk select, labelled "Means of transport to the port of entry" and opening on "Select one" (app/views/arrival-details.html:110-120, app/data/means-of-transport.js). The five questions on the page then read as a uniform column of labelled controls.
finding.difference: Change the radios to a select with the same four options and a "Select one" placeholder. The option set and the field name do not change, so nothing downstream moves — including the rule that Railway or Road Vehicle brings the transit-countries page into the journey, which both sides already share.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding DR1's means of transport rendered as radios rather than a select on any page in the DR1 corpus.
finding.correction: VERIFIED SOUND from both pictures and both sources. DR1 renders the question as a govukSelect opening on 'Select one' (app/views/arrival-details.html:110-121); the frontend renders four radios — Airplane, Railway, Road Vehicle, Vessel — with nothing preselected, and the captured screenshots show both. The option set and the field name are the same on both sides. The finding's promise that nothing downstream moves also holds: the rule that Railway or Road Vehicle brings the transit-countries page into the journey is shared, DR1's TRANSIT_MEANS_OF_TRANSPORT being ['Railway', 'Road Vehicle'] (app/routes.js:49) against the frontend gating transitedCountries on ['RAILWAY', 'ROAD_VEHICLE'] (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/transport.js:88-104).
